items.title: BoF: Demna's Gucci back under the microscope as Milan Fashion Week opens
items.summary: Trade press previews Demna's second in-person Gucci runway show (Sept 25, Milan), framing it as a test of whether his February reset is translating into cultural and commercial traction a year into his tenure. Notes the show lands the same week as Maria Grazia Chiuri's second Fendi collection and Meryll Rogge's second Marni turn, positioning it as a bellwether for the bag conversation heading into 2027. Balanced anticipatory framing rather than pure promotion -- flags stakes and open questions about whether the debut's momentum holds.

items.title: WWD: Milan Fashion Week September 2026 schedule confirms Gucci show details
items.summary: Trade outlet's official schedule guide for Milan Fashion Week (Sept 22-28, SS27 womenswear) confirms Gucci's Demna-led show slot, alongside Prada opening the week for the first time. Straight scheduling/service journalism with light framing of Gucci as one of the week's most-watched fixtures, given Demna's ongoing turnaround mandate.

items.title: Kering stock holds steady as investors watch for confirmation of Gucci-led recovery
items.summary: German financial-news outlet reports Kering shares trading stably on Euronext Paris as investors assess whether Gucci's improved H1 2026 US retail traction will convert into sustained comparable-sales growth; notes market is watching for a shift from negative to positive comps and whether operating margins hold via pricing discipline. Neutral financial-market signal, not brand-authored.

items.title: Independent fashion-commentary Substack argues Demna's Gucci reflects a broader 'luxury identity crisis'
items.summary: Independent (non-brand, non-wire) fashion-criticism newsletter argues Demna's cautious, archive-leaning approach at Gucci exemplifies how major luxury houses now favor 'proven moneymakers' over creative risk-taking, contrasting his restrained Gucci output with his more radical Balenciaga era. Explicitly critical-angle community/creator commentary; quotes fan/commenter sentiment that 'safe is not what gucci needs.' Engagement metrics (likes/shares) not exposed on the public post view, left null.

items.title: Instagram fashion-commentary repost of Gucci FW looks draws split comments ahead of second Demna show
items.summary: Fan/commentary repost account sharing Gucci FW looks by Demna sees comment-thread split between praise for the tailoring and recurring criticism that the collection 'plays it safe' and leans too heavily on Tom Ford-era archive references rather than forging new ground. Consistent with wider social discourse captured by trade press; individual like/comment counts not visible in accessible view, left null per no-fabrication rule.

items.title: Celebrity-lifestyle outlet notes online audiences remain 'divided' over Gucci runway styling months after debut
items.summary: Lifestyle/celebrity outlet recaps that online reaction to Emily Ratajkowski's body-conscious Gucci runway look has stayed contentious in ongoing social discourse, split between fans praising the confidence of the styling and critics calling it overly sexualized or derivative of past eras. Low-tier but genuine public-sentiment thermometer distinct from brand messaging; resurfaced in current pre-show social conversation ahead of the Sept 25 collection.

items.title: PurseForum quality-complaints thread remains active with new stitching/hardware reports
items.summary: Ongoing collector-community thread continues to accumulate reports of stitching separation, hardware tarnishing, and post-repair finish mismatches on recently purchased Gucci leather goods; some members push back, citing satisfactory repair experiences. Independent critical-angle community signal included per anti-bias mandate; view/reply counts not exposed via public access, left null.

items.title: Gucci reportedly not renewing lease on historic Avenue Montaigne Paris flagship
items.summary: Italian fashion-trade outlet reports Gucci and Kering have gone quiet on renewing the lease for the 1,500 sqm Avenue Montaigne boutique in Paris's Golden Triangle, with the lease expiring at year-end amid a rent dispute with the building's owners; Gucci is said to be preparing a new flagship at Rue Saint-Honore/Rue Castiglione instead. Critical-angle EU retail-footprint story tied to the broader ~275-store closure plan; outside the 14-day freshness window but included as directly relevant background to the ongoing EU store-rationalization narrative still shaping current coverage.

items.title: UK fashion outlet recaps Gucci's 2026 sales slump and continuing AI-imagery backlash
items.summary: Consumer fashion-media outlet summarizes Gucci's 2026 reset -- softening demand across the US, Europe and China, reduced store traffic, and continued social-media criticism that heavier AI use in design/advertising risks making products feel standardized and undermines craftsmanship authenticity -- alongside the brand's F1/Alpine tie-up aimed at attracting younger audiences. Outside 14-day freshness window; included as consolidated critical-angle background still echoed in current EU social commentary.

items.title: Reuters: Gucci's Demna presents 'Primavera' debut collection in first fashion show for the house
items.summary: Wire-service report on Demna's February runway debut for Gucci, still the primary T1 reference point cited across ongoing trade coverage previewing his September follow-up show. Kept as background anchor for the currently unfolding 'second Demna show' storyline; outside 14-day window.
